cause.summary: guardWhisperPipeline 通过 originalProcessor.apply(this,args) 调用 Xenova Callable processor；Callable 构造器把函数对象原型替换为具体类 prototype，因而实例不继承 Function.prototype，processor.apply 为 undefined。真实 pipeline 首先 await this.processor(subarr)，包装器在进入 processor _call 前抛 TypeError，故 model.generate 计数为 0。

source_chain.evidence: this.model.generate occurs only after processor output is collected

memberApply.name: TypeError
memberApply.stack:
TypeError: processor.apply is not a function
    at file:///private/tmp/t1062-callable-processor-apply-repro.mjs:17:19

reproduction.constraints: Imported only real Xenova Callable and used a virtual processor; no model, decoder, audio, database, browser, or network.

r2_consistency.outerError: MultimodalGenerationError: whisper-local(worker)执行失败: inference failed

minimal_in_scope_fix.required_change: Use Reflect.apply(originalProcessor,this,args) (or Function.prototype.apply.call) so invocation does not depend on Function.prototype being in the callable object prototype chain.
minimal_in_scope_fix.required_regression: Add a processor fixture derived from the real @xenova/transformers Callable shape (member .apply absent), run it through the actual AutomaticSpeechRecognitionPipeline/guard path with virtual neural generation, and assert chunk identity/valid length, restoration, error and cancellation behavior.
minimal_in_scope_fix.excluded: No dependency upgrade, timing criterion change, tail clamp, model/network behavior change, or new fallback.

required_after_fix_evidence: Re-run the four ASR test files plus cancellation and ai-worker typecheck against the new exact hashes.
Build a fresh esbuild worker from the fixed source and run the no-model real-Callable pipeline regression; old bundle evidence cannot prove the changed bytes.

Then run exactly one fresh authorized real createDefaultWhisperLocalAdapter fixed-WAV regression with network denied and cache/source before-after hashes, and require model.generate > 0 plus strict timing result. This diagnosis does not authorize or claim that run.
Public reserve/settle, packaged app, and installed app remain unverified.
not_claimed: No model inference was run by this review.
No decoder was run by this review.
The exact swallowed worker stack was not recovered; the deterministic pre-generate failure is established independently and matches all observed counters.
